scene.speaker: nico
scene.bubble: Action time! Walk, stop, turn, jump… my favourite class is the moving class!
scene.intro: Action time with Nico and Freya! Walk, walk, walk… STOP! Look at the window. Listen to the birds. Clap your hands three times. Turn around. Touch your nose. Point at something blue. Nico always does the wrong one and everybody laughs, and then everybody starts again. This is the moving class, the favourite class of the week. Stand up: can you follow all the actions?

data.script: Nico: Action game! Stand up, everyone! … Nico: Walk to the window… and stop! … Freya: Stopped! What now? … Nico: Turn around two times. … Freya: One… two! I'm dizzy! … Nico: Point to the door. Now point to the board! … Nico: Clap four times… and sit down! … Freya: That was fun! Now you play and I say the actions!
